jobDetails.title: Salesforce commerce cloud Support Engineer
jobDetails.description:
Role- Salesforce commerce cloud (SFCC) Support Engineer

Desired Experience Range- 7-12 Years

Location- Pan India


Job Summary-

We are looking for a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Support Engineer with strong hands-on experience in supporting and troubleshooting e-commerce applications. The candidate will be responsible for production support, incident resolution, monitoring, debugging, and maintaining Salesforce Commerce Cloud applications.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for Salesforce Commerce Cloud applications.
  • Troubleshoot application, integration, performance, and production issues.
  • Analyze logs and identify root causes for SFCC application failures.
  • Handle incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and defect resolution.
  • Support SFCC storefront functionality, including catalog, products, pricing, promotions, checkout, orders, and customer-related flows.
  • Troubleshoot integrations between SFCC and payment, order-management, inventory, CRM, and other third-party systems.
  • Work with JavaScript, APIs, REST/SOAP services, JSON, HTML and CSS for debugging and minor fixes.
  • Support deployments, releases, hot fixes, and post-production validation.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and document recurring production issues.
  • Coordinate with development, QA, infrastructure, and business teams for issue resolution.
  • Monitor application health and help improve platform stability and performance.

Mandatory Skills

  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC / B2C Commerce)
  • Production/Application Support
  • L2/L3 Support
  • SFCC development/support experience
  • JavaScript
  • REST APIs / Web Services
  • E-commerce domain knowledge
  • Troubleshooting and debugging
  • Incident & Problem Management

Good to Have

  • SFRA
  • Business Manager
  • OCAPI / SCAPI
  • HTML / CSS
  • Payment gateway integrations
  • Order Management integrations
  • Git / CI/CD
  • ServiceNow or similar ticketing tools
